guards.what: Rip (BrainLeech.cs:51-61): 5 damage, then RewardCount iterations of a 3-card COLORLESS CardReward offered through RewardsCmd.OfferCustom -- a SKIPPABLE screen
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): The screens are OFFERED through the mid-event OfferCustom channel. `Event.pending_rewards` is the sim's port of an `await RewardsCmd.OfferCustom(player, rewards)` that an option itself awaits: the driver reads it as soon as the option returns and offers it before asking for the next page, which is where the await sits. (That channel was itself verified live this round -- see creature_card_cmds/step38a, closed STALE on an executed Dense Vegetation run.) `rewards.create_reward_cards` is the faithful CreateForReward port and was already in place.  This site: BrainLeech.cs:51-61 takes the 5 damage and then hands `RewardCount` (IntVar 1, BrainLeech.cs:32) 3-card COLOURLESS CardRewards to RewardsCmd.OfferCustom -- a SKIPPABLE screen. events/brain_leech.py built the right cards with the right flags but then ran them through `run.select_cards`, which always returns a card when the candidate list is non-empty, so the player could not decline: the colourless pool holds curses and situational cards. The source distinguishes the two screens deliberately -- SHARE_KNOWLEDGE sets `Cancelable = false` and RIP does not -- and the sim now does too. EXECUTED: taking RIP leaves the deck UNCHANGED and parks one 3-card group on `pending_rewards`; SHARE_KNOWLEDGE still adds its card immediately.  Pinned by test/test_event_live_tail.py.  NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site.  The text it replaced read: events/brain_leech.py takes the damage and builds the same 3-card colourless choice with the same flags (NoRarityModification|NoCardPoolModifications -> mutate_pity=False, modify_hooks=False), but then does `for card in self.run.select_cards('card_reward', cards, 1): add_card(card)`, and select_cards always returns a card when the candidate list is non-empty (run.py). The player cannot decline the card. That is observable: the colourless pool contains curses and situational cards, and BrainLeech's own SHARE_KNOWLEDGE branch shows the source distinguishes the two screens deliberately -- it sets `Cancelable = false` there and uses plain OfferCustom here. Unlike the Battleworn Dummy potion case there is no driver-level skip to fall back on: the card is added inside the event. LIVE -- Brain Leech is eligible in acts 1-2 with no other gate.

guards.what: G-new (found and FIXED 2026-07-31, tier-2 campaign, Task 32): mid-event RewardsCmd.OfferCustom skipped Hook.ModifyRewards
guards.maps_to: events/brain_leech.py::BrainLeech._rip now calls apply_reward_modifiers before setting pending_rewards
guards.issue: G-new (found and FIXED 2026-07-31, tier-2 campaign, Task 32): the mid-event reward screen skipped the reward-modifier dispatch. C# calls Hook.ModifyRewards from RewardsSet.GenerateWithoutOffering (RewardsSet.cs:136), which EVERY RewardsSet passes through, so a reward-modifying relic applies on any screen. This event built a CombatRewards directly and handed it to driver.py._run_event's mid-event pending_rewards channel, which offers it without calling apply_reward_modifiers -- so a player holding Driftwood got a non-rerollable CardReward where the game offers a reroll. LIVE, not dormant: both this event and Driftwood are fully ported and reachable. Found by unit work on relic/_reward_late_pass (Task 31), confirmed live by that task's reviewer, fixed by dispatching apply_reward_modifiers at the construction site. Per-site rather than central: driver.py's _offer_rewards has three other callers that already dispatch at construction time (rewards.py:698,761; run.py; glass_eye.py:78), so a central call would DOUBLE-dispatch and duplicate AmethystAubergine/BlackStar/LavaRock gold and relics -- verified by the task reviewer. R10 (2026-08-01) closed this tension: `CombatRewards.generated` (rewards.py) plus a backstop `apply_reward_modifiers` call in `driver._offer_rewards` and `RunState.offer_rewards` mirror the two dispatch entry points C# actually has -- generate-time for room-end sets (`RewardsCmd.cs:55-60`, `GenerateForRoomEnd`) and offer-time for every `RewardsCmd.OfferCustom` set (`RewardsCmd.cs:47-50`, which has NO generate-time call -- `Offer()`'s call at `RewardsSet.cs:159` is that set's first and only dispatch), both funnelled through the `_isGenerated`-guarded `GenerateWithoutOffering` (`RewardsSet.cs:127-130/146`, re-called at `:159`) -- so a future event built this same way is dispatched exactly once even if it forgets the explicit call. Pinned: test/test_reward_dispatch_choke_point.py. The reasoning this replaces: the per-site fix was structurally fragile going forward; that fragility is now closed, not patched.

guards.issue: Confirmed live exactly as recorded — modify_hooks=False suppressed the whole hook dispatch instead of setting NoRarityModification | NoCardPoolModifications. FIXED via the same construction-site rewrite as g6: flags=NO_UPGRADE_ROLL|NO_RARITY_MODIFICATION|NO_CARD_POOL_MODIFICATIONS (no NO_MODIFY_HOOKS), and is_card_reward=True now set unconditionally by CardRewardGroup.populate() -- a SECOND defect the record didn't name (both relics also gate on IsCardReward, which the old hand-rolled call never set, even on the first draw).
